Class SentenceGeneratorTest

java.lang.Object
it.unipd.nonsense.utils.SentenceGeneratorTest
public class SentenceGeneratorTest extends Object
Test class for SentenceGenerator. Verifies the functionality of sentence generation including: - Template processing with placeholders - Word substitution from custom lists - Default dictionary usage - Error handling for invalid inputs

    • testGenerateSentences_WithCustomWords

      IOException - if dictionary operations fail
